text: S3.7 slice 2b/3 candidate adds an uncounted RealPrepared.configure route and backend-owned native CountCursor pages. Initial and ready receipts carry canonical plan/input bindings; ready also retains the exact typed recipe. CountingWork reports native schedule work, with cardinality diagnostics counted separately rather than fabricated participant progress. Full receipts reject unknown, premature, tampered and stale submission, and exact retained preparation starts the job. Preview rows derive from native matched/control schedules and admission ledger, are cached per immutable revision, and retain no-match/not-admitted query rows with absent reference values. New shared tiny-cursor and JVM full-ledger/backend tests are written; integration build/testing pending the shared build slot. Current single-reference PreviewRow explicitly refuses multiple matched references or missing response fields instead of picking a reference or inventing a category.
